title: Fix empty MIME boundary string bypasses parse_multipart None guard
description: core/ipld/mime_parser.rs parse_multipart guards against absent boundary via ? (returns None). But Content-Type: multipart/mixed; boundary= (present but empty) gives Some(""). Empty boundary turns every '--' line into a delimiter, corrupting MIME CID subtrees. Fix: validate \!boundary.is_empty() && boundary.len() <= 70 before use.
